faqs.question: What is Beacon Help Center?
faqs.answer: Beacon is a self-serve help center where you can search for answers, browse guides by category, and reach our support team if you're still stuck.

faqs.question: Is Beacon free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes. Browsing articles, searching the help center, and contacting support are completely free for every visitor.

faqs.question: Which browsers are supported?
faqs.answer: Beacon works on the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend keeping your browser updated for the best experience.

faqs.question: Can I use Beacon on my phone?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — the help center is fully responsive and can even be installed as an app on your home screen.

faqs.question: How do I switch the interface language?
faqs.answer: Use the language switcher in the navbar to toggle between English and Hindi. Your choice is remembered on this device.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Click Sign Up in the navbar, enter your email and a password, and confirm your email address to activate the account.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Go to the login screen and select Forgot Password. We'll email you a secure link to set a new password.

faqs.question: How do I update my profile details?
faqs.answer: Open Account Settings from your profile menu, edit the fields you'd like to change, and click Save.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to Account Settings, scroll to Danger Zone, and select Delete Account. This action is permanent and removes all your data.

faqs.question: Can I merge two accounts?
faqs.answer: Account merging isn't automated yet. Contact support with both account emails and we'll assist manually.

faqs.question: Why was I logged out automatically?
faqs.answer: Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity, or immediately if you change your password, for your security.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and popular wallets at checkout.

faqs.question: How do I update my billing information?
faqs.answer: Go to Billing under Account Settings, select Update Payment Method, and enter your new card details.

faqs.question: Why did my payment fail?
faqs.answer: Payments usually fail due to insufficient funds, an expired card, or your bank blocking the transaction. Try another method or contact your bank.

faqs.question: How do I request a refund?
faqs.answer: Open a support ticket with your order ID within 14 days of purchase and our billing team will review your request.

faqs.question: Where can I find my invoices?
faqs.answer: All invoices are available under Billing History in your account, and can be downloaded as PDF.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Go to Orders in your account dashboard and click Track on any order to see real-time status updates.

faqs.question: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement from the Orders page. After that, contact support directly.

faqs.question: How do I change my delivery address?
faqs.answer: If the order hasn't shipped yet, edit the address from Orders > Order Details > Edit Address.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Items can be returned within 30 days in original condition. Start a return from the Orders page to get a prepaid label.

faqs.question: Why is my order delayed?
faqs.answer: Delays are usually caused by high demand or courier disruptions. Check the tracking page for the latest estimated delivery date.

faqs.question: The website isn't loading properly, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Try clearing your browser cache, disabling extensions, or switching browsers. If the issue continues, let support know your browser and OS.

faqs.question: I found a bug — how do I report it?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact Support form and select Bug Report as the subject. Include steps to reproduce and a screenshot if possible.

faqs.question: Does Beacon work offline?
faqs.answer: Yes, previously visited pages are cached and remain viewable offline thanks to the built-in service worker.

faqs.question: How do I install Beacon as an app?
faqs.answer: On supported browsers, click the Install icon in the address bar, or use Add to Home Screen on mobile.

faqs.question: Can I use keyboard shortcuts?
faqs.answer: Press / to jump to search, Esc to close any open panel, and Ctrl+K to open the AI assistant.

faqs.question: What data does Beacon collect about me?
faqs.answer: We only collect what's needed to run your account: your email, basic usage analytics, and support conversations. See our Privacy Policy for details.

faqs.question: Can I download a copy of my data?
faqs.answer: Yes, request a data export from Account Settings > Privacy, and we'll email you a download link within 48 hours.

faqs.question: Do you sell my data to third parties?
faqs.answer: No. We never sell personal data. Some anonymised analytics may be shared with service providers strictly to operate the platform.

faqs.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
faqs.answer: Go to Account Settings > Security and turn on Two-Factor Authentication, then scan the QR code with an authenticator app.

faqs.question: I think my account was hacked, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Reset your password immediately, enable two-factor authentication, and contact support so we can review recent account activity.

faqs.question: How do I see my active login sessions?
faqs.answer: Visit Account Settings > Security > Active Sessions to view and revoke access from any device.

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact Support form on this page, chat with the assistant, or email us — we usually reply within one business day.

faqs.question: What are your support hours?
faqs.answer: Our team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM IST. The AI assistant is available around the clock.

faqs.question: Do you offer phone support?
faqs.answer: Phone support is available for Pro and Enterprise plans. Everyone else can reach us via the contact form or chat.
